notes: Counter-Strike 2 matchmaking, as converted from CS2CD by examples/cs2/cs2cd.py. Not affiliated with Valve. Aim is scored per weapon class (rifle, sniper, smg, pistol, shotgun, mg). Every movement sample carries its own cap, 250 units/s (6.35 m/s, knife out), the fastest anything moves on foot; per-weapon caps are tighter but live in compiled game data, so this cap is deliberately loose. Fire-rate and metronome rules are off: CS2's cycle times are not in the public item schema, and the server enforces them anyway. The spray pattern is fixed, so recoil_pattern is learnable. tick_ms is unset because a 64-tick server's tick is 15.625 ms and the field takes whole milliseconds.
